input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and deletion certification obligation in Section 17
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard exit clause requiring Garman to provide transition assistance for up to six months at its then-current rates, to return our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days and to certify deletion thereafter, since the Agreement currently imposes no data-return or migration obligations on Garman outside the Section 8 rejection scenario. We can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is difficult.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (i) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) calendar days, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data and Confidential Information in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
